title: Real-estate landing hero: search-first with a scooped corner
attribution_visible_in_image: 'My Home' logo in the mockup; no creator credit visible.
contains_third_party_content: Airbnb, Cisco, eBay and Microsoft logos; a building photograph; a phone number appears in the image.

observed.layout: Grey page with a white rounded frame. A dark slate hero with a building photo at the right. Nav: 'My Home' logo, Home (active, orange underline dot), Properties, Members, Pages, Blogs, Log in, an outlined 'Sign Up' pill. Headline 'Choose Your Best Happy Land', sub 'Real Estate & Properties For Sale Or Rent In 12+ Country'. A white search bar: Property type (Show all), Price range (Any price), a purple 'Search' button; then 'Buy a home' and 'Rent a home' toggles. A coral label 'Our Special Service' over a carousel of dark cards ('Comfortable' with 'Facebook Ads, Google Ads, Linkedin Ads,'; 'Luxury...' cut off). The hero's bottom edge has a scooped corner that meets a white strip: a property card (Jakarta Barat, Indonesia, 4 bed, 10x10 m, $5,200,000, a green 'Book Now' tag) and four logo chips. Small white text with a lime link at the bottom right of the photo ('Give us a Call ...').
observed.typography: Bold geometric headline; small sans nav and copy. Typeface unconfirmed.
observed.iconography: Small outline icons in the search fields.
observed.materials: Dark hero with a scooped corner, white search bar, translucent dark cards.

implementation_notes: Scooped corner via a masked or pseudo-element cut-out.
Carousel of service cards cropped by the container.

concept_work.essence: Search directly under the headline, plus an instant proof strip.
what_makes_it_work: The search form is the first thing under the headline.
The scooped corner links hero and strip.
A sample property card and partner logos give instant proof.
gaps_to_make_it_work: The 'special service' cards list ad platforms, not property services; the logos are tech brands, not real-estate partners.
'Our Special Service' label measures about 2.22-2.31:1; card copy about 2.95-3.23:1.
Many accents (orange, coral, lime, purple, green); 'Book Now' looks like a second primary action.

links: The purple Search button is the primary action.
The 'Book Now' tag competes as a second primary-looking action.

pattern.name: Search-first hero with a scoop transition
use_when: Marketplaces where search is the core action
avoid_when: The content is unreviewed (placeholder copy breaks trust)
adaptation_examples: Car marketplace: same search-first hero with make and price range.
Job board: role and location fields.

lessons: Review placeholder copy and logos so they match the product.
Limit the accent palette to one action color.

measured.palette_method: Median-cut quantization of the supplied image plus saturated-pixel hue medians. Approximate (JPEG). Items marked 'approx' were judged by eye.
measured.color_roles: Dark slate hero, white search bar, purple action; coral, lime and green appear as extra accents.
measured.contrast_method: Estimated from compressed images. Background = dominant color in a box around the text. ratio_low = conservative estimate (mean of the most distant ~4% of pixels). ratio = best estimate (mean of the most distant ~1.5% of pixels; for text on a saturated background that appears near-white or near-black, the text is assumed pure white or black, because anti-aliasing of small text otherwise understates the contrast). Accessibility scores use ratio_low; critical failure CF1 uses ratio. Gradient or photo backgrounds are measured one text line at a time. Values within 0.4 of a threshold are borderline and should be verified in the source file.

evidence: The search-first structure is clear, but copy and logos do not match the product.
Competent hero but busy, with many accent colors.
Hero and search conventions are met; the mismatched service cards and partner logos break content correctness.
Search is easy to find; the Buy/Rent toggles' relation to search is unclear.
Radii and type are consistent but accents are not.
A familiar real-estate hero with a scoop transition.
Scored on conservative values: primary text min 2.22:1; secondary text min 2.95:1; icon min n/a:1; non-color state cue: True.
accessibility.basis: computed from measured contrast + cue flag (scope: contrast and non-color cues only; touch targets, motion and screen-reader support cannot be assessed from a static image)

critical_failures.description: A primary text/label measures below 3:1 contrast (best estimate)

evaluation.readiness_key: A = ship with minor adjustments (>=80, no critical failure); B = needs specific fixes (60-79); C = rethink (<60)
evaluation.scope: Scored as presented in a static image. States, motion and behavior that are not shown are not scored as present.
